verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable data-integration platform like Airbyte, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection, or any opt-out setting or environment variable. The deployment docs (abctl, Kubernetes, OSS quickstart) cover installation only and say nothing about disabling tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
